proves.claim: updateMainReds, closing a fixed Main red, appends one note on each open item whose red gate failed on its file and case.

cli.test-main-reds.notifies-failed-items.why: Without it, a fixed Main red would leave the items it blocked red with no word that it is fixed, or tell items it never blocked.

proves.claim: an item whose red failures name another file or case gets no note, and a second run that closes nothing writes no duplicate note.

cli.test-main-reds.skips-other-items-and.why: Without it, a fixed Main red would leave the items it blocked red with no word that it is fixed, or tell items it never blocked.
